quarantined.reason: to247-thermal-block-belongs-to-another-package-variant: no TO-247 variant of this die exists to re-source the row from. Renesas/Transphorm sell the 650 V / 150 mOhm Gen-4 SuperGaN die as TP65H150G4PS (TO-220, RthJC 1.5 K/W, PD 83 W), TP65H150G4LSG and TP65H150G4LSGBE (PQFN88, RthJC 2.4 and 2.0 K/W, PD 52 W) and TP65H150BG4JSG (PQFN56) -- four SKUs, none in TO-247, and every one carries a package suffix that this record's bare 'TP65H150G4' lacks. The stored TO-247-4 / RthJC 3.5 K/W / PD 25 W matches no published variant, and the record's own datasheetUrl (transphormusa.com/document/tp65h150g4-datasheet/) now redirects to the Renesas GaN category landing page.
